reason: Fresh trusted-main discrimination after the post-KF-P0-20 ledger merge found a live KF-P0-24 candidate root on Telegram media: telegramAdapter returns provider-accepted outbound-media-upsert repair data with sourceFile/expectedSha256 at the repair root, while localPersistenceRepairService consumes only payload.source.filePath or payload.source.bufferBase64. The canonical outbound durable operation persists platform repair payloads unchanged except for WhatsApp-specific file custody. Telegram media can therefore enter durable local repair after provider acceptance with a payload the canonical consumer cannot materialize, and file-backed repair also lacks a proven durable byte-custody boundary across restart. This authorization grants only one fresh tests-only causal diagnostic. No production fix is authorized until mandatory exact-head execution proves a finding-specific RED with unknownBlockers=0 and a separate production authorization ordinary-merges.

causalHypothesis.currentRoot: Telegram's provider-accepted outbound-media-upsert repair contract is not consumable by the canonical durable local-repair authority: the adapter emits sourceFile/expectedSha256 at the repair root while LocalPersistenceRepairService requires payload.source.filePath or payload.source.bufferBase64, and OutboundMessageSendOperation currently takes file-byte custody only for WhatsApp. This can terminalize a Telegram repair after the remote send has already succeeded, leaving the canonical local projection unrepairable without unsafe resend.

Require the persisted Telegram media repair to remain consumable by LocalPersistenceRepairService after the caller-owned source path is unavailable, without a second provider send.
Prove the current failure is the Telegram repair-shape/custody boundary only, while deterministic repair identity and non-media message-upsert repair remain preserved.
Require mandatory Stage execution to contain only the finding-specific expected failure and unknownBlockers=0 before any production authorization.

Existing deterministic repair identity local-repair-${attemptId} remains the idempotency seam unless fresh RED proves it insufficient.

Existing LocalPersistenceRepairService/repository and canonical OutboundMessageSendOperation remain the only repair/durable authorities; no second queue, scheduler, database or workflow engine may be introduced.

Do not add a new dependency or generalized blob-custody subsystem before the fresh causal RED proves such a requirement.
